# Game Idea: Cosmic Runner

A side‑scrolling endless runner implemented on an HTML canvas. The player controls a ship that constantly moves forward; clicking/tapping makes it thrust upward against gravity. Random asteroids and laser beams scroll in from the right. The player loses if the ship collides with any obstacle or touches the bottom edge of the canvas. The goal is to survive as long as possible and collect stars for a high score.
